proposal.thesis: Starter second seat in software_platforms via Dynatrace, the top universe setup at 7.66, after NTAP/OKTA stops freed cash and ZS proved untradeable as a non-fractionable name on this book size. Live ~$63.5 holds above the 50/200-DMA with a weekly uptrend; print 11/04 is outside the coded 3-day blackout. Softening momentum_health caps size at starter (0.5% risk), not full. Street mean target near $62 sits under the print and is sentiment only — my measured move is a retest of the recent high area toward $74.
catalysts: Highest swing_setup_score in today's full universe scan (7.66)
Observability/AI-ops demand with net expansion still the swing debate into the 11/04 print
Second software_platforms seat allowed with score above the held NOW seat
proposal.macro_context: Book is 46% deployed with a free probe/starter lane after two morning stop-outs. Softening factor momentum argues against full-risk software, so this is a half-risk starter in the top-scoring name rather than a chase of SHOP/PLTR.
proposal.risk_map: A close through $59.50 ends it. Early tell is a break of $62 with software peers making fresh lows together; also watch for a pre-print guide cut before 11/04.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: Dynatrace screens extended (RSI ~70, mean target ~$62 under the tape) and looks like another software duration name to avoid while 10y yields rise. MY VIEW: the scan score and weekly uptrend say this is the cleanest software structure left after NOW already reclaimed $145, and a second seat is legal when the challenger outscores the holder. MECHANISM: consensus anchors on the stale mean target and RSI; it underweights that NOW is already the working software seat and DT is the highest-scoring continuation with room to a measured $74 retest of the high area — the mispricing is treating a top-scoring uptrend as unbuyable because the street target lags. RESOLUTION: a daily close above $68 inside two weeks confirms; a close below $59.50 says the starter failed.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: Any guide cut or consensus FY revenue estimate cuts of more than 5% before exit, or a net-expansion print that breaks below 110%.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: Daily close below $59.50 on rising volume, or loss of the 50-DMA with DT lagging the software group.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If DT has not closed above $68 by 2026-11-01, exit or cut before the 11/04 print; do not carry a stalled starter into that binary without a separate earnings_case.

September five-week sales were $30.02B (+13% y/y) with digitally enabled sales +19%, and the board declared a $1.47 quarterly dividend on 10/14 payable 11/13. Live ~$987 sits above the stated add level with ~$34 of room under the ~$199 position cap, trailing stop $944 (~2.5 ATR). No company print until 12/10. Measured add target $1100 restores +10% upside and RR>=2 from the new entry; street targets near ~$1080 are context only.
catalysts: Membership/comps momentum confirmed by September sales (+13%) and digital +19%
Defensive bid while AI/software momentum softens
proposal.macro_context: Rising 10y yields and softening momentum ETFs favor finishing a profitable defensive diversifier over stacking more duration-sensitive risk. Oil firm and VIX calming off yesterday's spike support the broad_market ballast.
proposal.risk_map: A sharp membership-comp miss or a break of the $944 trail on rising volume kills the add. Early tell is a close back under $975 with the trail tightening; size is capped so a full stop is a small equity hit.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: street treats COST as an expensive defensive compounder (targets clustered near ~$1080, RSI ~72) and assumes the easy money was the squeeze toward the $1000 handle. MY VIEW: the $980 shelf holding after today's ~$1008 tag is the add we queued across overnight and morning slots, and finishing a working starter under the position cap beats idle cash at ~54%. MECHANISM: consensus frames valuation as the blocker; the 3-90d swing mispricing is path — membership flywheel and digital mix keep defending while AI-factor softens, so the remaining units should be filled on a held pullback rather than waited for a deep drawdown that may not come before 12/10. RESOLUTION: a daily close back under $975 or a trail hit at $944 proves the shelf failed; a hold above $1000 into November sales confirms the add.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: A monthly sales release showing comps ex-gas/FX decelerating more than 5% y/y, or a membership-renewal rate drop of more than 5 percentage points that implies the flywheel is breaking.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: Daily close below the $944 trailing stop on rising volume, or a failed hold of $975 after this add.
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If COST has not held a close above $1020 by 2026-11-20, trim the add and reassess; full exit still governed by the trail.
